rate_limits: 15 requests per second with a burst of 30; on average, fewer than 15 requests per second. Excess requests receive HTTP 429. Calls over time are unlimited.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: ORIGINAL is incorrect. Current official documentation specifies a leaky-bucket limit of 15 requests per second, permits bursts up to 30 in one second, returns HTTP 429 when exceeded, and allows unlimited calls over time. Evidence: https://data.police.uk/docs/api-call-limits/
